title: Multilinear degree bound
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued coefficient function $a$ on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and a natural number $k$, say that $a$ has multilinear degree at most $k$ if $a(S)=0$ for every finite set $S$ whose cardinality is strictly greater than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued coefficient function on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$
